title: Passage: To the camp
standardSummary: Read an army passage with 3rd-conjugation verbs; answer who sends/takes/fights.
teach: Army narrative with regō-type and -iō verbs.

seeds.prompt: Whom does the leader send to camp?

passage.title: The camp
passage.latin:
Dux mīlitēs ad castra mittit.
Mīlitēs arma capiunt.
Hostēs nōn vincimus hodiē.
Crās pugnābimus et vincēmus.
passage.notes: mittit capiunt vincimus — 3rd conjugation · Use known vocabulary; guess from context only if needed.
